name: 🍏 Homemade Apple Pop-Tarts
what: Flaky puff pastry with warm cinnamon apples inside and a sweet glaze.
early: Thaw the puff pastry in the fridge the night before.

core.name: Puff pastry (2 sheets)
core.out: pie crust works, a little less flaky

core.name: Apples
core.out: any apples, or a few spoons of jam

extras: lemon, butter, cornstarch, powdered sugar + milk for the glaze

moves.text: Pull the must-haves onto the counter. Oven to 400°F, parchment on a pan.
Cook diced apples with butter, brown sugar and cinnamon. Let it cool all the way.
Cut each pastry sheet into 8. Filling on 8, egg on the edges, the other 8 on top.
Press the edges with a fork, poke the tops, brush with egg. Bake.
Cool 10 minutes, then drizzle with powdered sugar mixed with a little milk.

key: Cool the filling all the way first. Warm filling melts the pastry and you lose the flakes.
plan_b: Out of apples? Ham and cheese pockets, same pastry.
